headline: UMOA: Côte d'Ivoire Raises 110 Billion FCFA and Consolidates Its Status as a Benchmark Sovereign Signature
summary: Côte d'Ivoire raised 110 billion FCFA on Tuesday, with a 201.90% cover ratio. Yields were 6.26% for three years and 7.03% for five years.
why: Côte d'Ivoire is the largest issuer in the West African Economic and Monetary Union's regional government bond market.
original_headline: UMOA : la Côte d’Ivoire lève 110 milliards de FCFA et conforte son statut de signature souveraine de référence
